<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 4, 2026 - Aug 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _L.H.Wotton_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "You have to answer a ridiculous amount of questions before it charges you an expensive subscription."
            2. _fedelglgrlexzk_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "This used to be such a good app but I cancelled my subscription over the addition of AI. No computer will ever be able to accurately tell you the amount of calories just from a picture, this is a scammy, useless functionality. The app design also used to be more clean and the old icon was better, I hate how everything has to be gamified and have a dumb mascot now, I'm an adult (and most of your userbase should be !!) this is a calorie counting app, it's so unnecessary"

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 20, 2026 - Aug 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _zymbalaria_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "I specifically bought the 7-day streak sign with diamonds, which was shown as active. Nevertheless, my streak of 306 days was deleted. The support emails me with text modules (“not possible on the system side”), while the social media team here in the App Store refers exactly to this support via a standard answer. A pure diversionary tactic! A technical bug in your app deletes purchased shields and paying customers are left in the lurch. My subscription expires on August 19th. and remains definitely canceled!"
            2. _Jimboss747_, Aug 7, 2026, 1/5: "App has a lot of bugs, you need to find better developers"
            3. _Dyakonova_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Very disappointed with both the app and its customer support. I paid for this app and used it every single day on the same phone, spending hours logging my meals. I even have Screen Time reports proving my daily usage. After losing my streak due to what appears to be a technical issue, I contacted support with evidence, but they refused to restore it or offer any compensation. On top of that, the photo analysis is often inaccurate. In my experience, it frequently miscalculates calories and other nutritional values, so I often have to correct them manually. It’s frustrating to pay for an app, invest so much time in it, and then receive no real help when something goes wrong. If keeping your streak matters to you, be aware that support may not help you if you encounter a technical issue."
<!--/ir-theme-->
